task: Moderate the set of discord messages in channel_logs.json and decide on an appropriate action and a mod-answer to give for each of them.

contract.task: Moderate the set of discord messages in channel_logs.json and decide on an appropriate action and a mod-answer to give for each of them.

clauses.instruction: Read the task-named Discord channel log file for offline moderation.
Extract the set of Discord messages to be moderated from the acquired channel log text.
Derive the appropriate moderation action for each extracted Discord message according to the task request and the message content.
Derive the mod-answer to give for each extracted Discord message, aligned with the corresponding moderation action.
